newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia stocks end mixed despite big takeover.
newsitem.headline: Colombia stocks end mixed despite big takeover.

text.p: Colombian stocks ended mixed Wednesday after a big takeover in the financial sector failed to generate much enthusiasm among investors.
Bogota's IBB index ended down 0.49 percent at 830.32 amid a greater-than-average volume of 17.8 billion pesos.
Of that total, some 14.1 billion pesos represented shares in the financial concern Corfitolima, purchased by Corfisantander, Colombia's one of largest companies, at 1,385 pesos each.
Medellin's IBOMED general price index edged up 0.08 percent to 13,211.64 in volume of 2.0 billion pesos.
